title: eleocharis ovata
intro: Eleocharis ovata, commonly known as Spike-Rush, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spike-Rush include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it useful in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Eleocharis ovata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
